name: Kempinski Hotel Barbaros Bay Bodrum
positioning: Kempinski Hotel Barbaros Bay Bodrum is a clifftop resort on the shores of Barbaros Bay, with a large spa, an infinity pool and a private beach.
best_for: Travelers who want a spa and beach resort on the Bodrum peninsula
Guests who prefer a quiet bay setting over staying in Bodrum town

facts.text: The hotel sits on the shores of Barbaros Bay on the Bodrum peninsula.
The hotel grounds cover 62.000 square meters.
The hotel is set on the cliffs of Barbaros Bay overlooking the Aegean Sea.
The hotel has an infinity pool.
The hotel has the 5500 sqm Kempinski Wellness & Spa.
The hotel has a private beach where guests can enjoy water sports.
The hotel has several restaurants serving global and local cuisines.
The hotel has a helipad for arrivals.
Bodrum Down Town is about 20 minutes and 15 km from the hotel.
The Castle of St. Peter is about 26 minutes and 16 km from the hotel.
The hotel offers a hotel limo transfer from Milas-Bodrum Airport.

considerations.text: Bodrum Down Town is about 20 minutes and 15 km from the hotel, and the Castle of St. Peter about 26 minutes and 16 km, so the hotel is a bay retreat rather than a town-center base.
WhataHotel notes the secluded location requires transportation to the Bodrum town center.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
